query:
SELECT
            id,
            workflow_type AS "workflow_type!",
            COALESCE(metadata->>'source_research_run_id', '') AS "source_research_run_id!"
         FROM workflow_runs
         WHERE organization_id = $1
           AND status = 'RUNNING'::workflow_run_status
           AND metadata->>'profile_id' = $2
           AND workflow_type IN ($3, $4)
         ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN workflow_type = $4
                 AND COALESCE(metadata->>'source_research_run_id', '') = $5 THEN 0
                WHEN workflow_type = $4 THEN 1
                ELSE 2
            END,
            created_at DESC,
            id DESC
         LIMIT 1
